frames.seen: A person in white traditional garments stands in a stone doorway looking out at an arid landscape where people walk with donkeys.
The person in white stands in the doorway as people and donkeys walk closer across the dirt landscape.
Floating hourglasses appear near the people and donkeys outside while the person in white watches from the doorway.
The person in the doorway is gone, and a large green tree now stands in the foreground with people and donkeys beneath it.
A small group of people and donkeys gather in the shade under the green tree.
The camera pans slightly right, showing two people with a donkey under the tree next to the dark interior wall.
A bright light shines on the distant mesh tower behind the tree while one person stands with a donkey.
Inside the dark room on the right, a woman in a headscarf lights a small fire in a bowl while people gather by the tree outside.
A man in white robes walks past a ball on the ground outside while the woman tends the fire inside.

overall: The world does not truly transform into new places, instead just dropping literal props like floating hourglasses, a tree, and a ball into the same static doorway view. The biggest weakness is the complete absence of the central walking Black man in black clothing and the lack of genuine environmental transitions.
